CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How much the beams or dots glow.
CONTROLS.NAME: glow_amount

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turns on the beam geometry. The glow_amount affects whether they glow or not.
CONTROLS.NAME: beams_on

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Replaces the beams with a field of dots.
CONTROLS.NAME: dot_field

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Makes the beams or dots dance.
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_groove

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Diameter of the tunnel.
CONTROLS.NAME: diameter

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Makes the tunnel stretch in waves.
CONTROLS.NAME: undulating

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Tunnel automatically rotates on bass.
CONTROLS.NAME: rotating

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Toggle and the tunnel will slowly unwind until it is just two flat planes.
CONTROLS.NAME: flatten

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Manually rotate the tunnel.
CONTROLS.NAME: manual_rotate

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Makes the overall lighting a more colorful orange/blue/green.
CONTROLS.NAME: colorful

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds cycling lights that fly down the tunnel ahead of you.
CONTROLS.NAME: light_chaser

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Makes the main light flash with the music.
CONTROLS.NAME: lights_react

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Brightness of the main light (that can be white or colorful) that lights the tunnel.
CONTROLS.NAME: main_light

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How much colorful fog there is in the distance.
CONTROLS.NAME: fog_col

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds more texture to the walls for light to catch.
CONTROLS.NAME: texture_on

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds deep spiral ridges to the overall tunnel.
CONTROLS.NAME: spiral_ridges

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sends a pulse down the tunnel. Combine vertical and horizontal for a good effect.
CONTROLS.NAME: undulate_up

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sends a pulse down the tunnel. Combine vertical and horizontal for a good effect.
CONTROLS.NAME: undulate_down

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sends a pulse down the tunnel. Combine vertical and horizontal for a good effect.
CONTROLS.NAME: undulate_left

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sends a pulse down the tunnel. Combine vertical and horizontal for a good effect.
CONTROLS.NAME: undulate_right

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How fast you fly into or out of the tunnel with bass.
CONTROLS.NAME: bass_travel

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How fast you fly into or out of the tunnel at a constant speed. Can go in the opposite direction of bass travel for good effects.
CONTROLS.NAME: travel

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Manually trigger a jump forward.
CONTROLS.NAME: jump_forward
